meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把设计元素变成动态短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字、数据或标识快速做成短小吸睛的动画片段
copy.tagline_en: Turn design elements into short motion graphics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want quick animated visuals for social posts or presentations.

howto.what: 装上后,当用户要求制作短视频动态图形时,Claude 会创建一段通常 10 秒以内、无旁白的设计感动画(如动态文字、数字递增、图表、logo揭示、地图、网页/UI 动画等),并渲染成 MP4 或透明覆盖层视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户请求制作短动态图形(如动画图表、文字动画、logo 揭示等),且目标时长通常在 10 秒内、无旁白时触发;若内容更长、带旁白或多场景,则转用 /general-video。

say.text: 把这句话做成动态文字,每个字依次弹出
say.note: 会生成一段动态文字动画视频。

say.text: 做一个数字从0涨到100万的计数动画
say.note: 会生成计数动画并渲染成视频。

say.text: 把这个 logo 做成开场动画,旋转后显示品牌名
say.note: 会创建 logo 揭示动画并输出。

howto.what_en: Creates short design-led motion graphics (usually <10s, unnarrated) like kinetic typography, count-ups, charts, logo reveals, maps, UI animations; renders as MP4 or transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests for short motion graphics (under ~10s, no narration): animated charts, text animations, logo reveals, etc. Longer/narrated/multi-scene work goes to /general-video.

say_en.text: Make this sentence kinetic typography, each character popping in one by one.
Create a count-up animation from 0 to 1,000,000.
Make this logo a sting intro: rotate it in and reveal the brand name.
